blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Open-set recognition (OSR) requires neural networks to classify known classes while rejecting unknown samples, which is critical for real-world deployment. So far, OSR research studied and developed representation learning and postprocessing methods independently and their interactions remain unexplored. In this paper, we reconsider OSR as a modular two-stage pipeline and present the first systematic study of interactions between representation learning and postprocessing methods across dataset scales and usage of known unknown data. First, we discover a failure mode we term \emph{magnitude collapse}, where representation learning methods that utilize known unknown data can suffer performance degradation at large scale and irreversibly destroy discriminative information, despite excelling at small scale. Second, we study the modular interactions and reveal when they can be leveraged for modular performance gains via two-stage processing and where interaction effects amplify performance degradation due to magnitude collapse. Third, we show how these findings can be used to achieve state-of-the-art performance with a simple $K+1$ class classifier baseline and magnitude-aware postprocessing while circumventing magnitude collapse. Finally, our results demonstrate that small-scale evaluations with known unknown data are not predictive of large-scale performance, invalidating current best practices in OSR research. Code available at https://github.com/TwoDigitsOneNumber/Two-Stage-OSR.
blocks.zh: Open-set识别(OSR)要求神经网络在拒绝未知样本的同时对已知类别进行分类,这对于现实世界的部署至关重要. 迄今为止,业务标准研究独立地研究和开发了代表学习和后处理方法,其相互作用仍未被探讨。 在本文中,我们重新考虑将业务标准作为模块化的两阶段程序,并介绍关于代表学习和后处理方法在数据集尺度上的相互作用以及已知未知数据的使用的第一次系统研究。 首先,我们发现了一种失败模式,我们称之为\emph{magnitude ball},在这个模式中,利用已知未知数据的代表性学习方法可能会发生大规模性能退化并不可逆转地破坏歧视性信息,尽管在小规模上表现优异。 第二,我们研究模块互动,并揭示何时可以通过两阶段处理为模块化性能收益利用这些互动,以及互动效应因规模倒塌而加剧性能退化。 第三,我们说明如何利用这些结论,在避免规模倒塌的同时,通过简单的$K+1美元类分级基线和体积认识后处理,实现最新性能。 最后,我们的结果表明,有已知未知数据的小规模评价不能预测大规模业绩,从而否定了目前业务社会责任研究的最佳做法。 在https://github.com/TwoDigits One Number/Two-Stage-OSR上可以找到代码.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
The rapid advancement of deep learning methods for image recognition increasingly promotes their real-world adoption, which requires them to adequately detect and handle unknown inputs for the reliability and safety of these systems [ Scheirer et al.(2013)Scheirer, de Rezende Rocha, Sapkota, and Boult , Hendrycks and Gimpel(2017) , Vaze et al.(2022)Vaze, Han, Vedaldi, and Zissermann ] .
This task is typically studied under the two closely-related problem formulations: Open-set Recognition (OSR) and Out-of-Distribution (OOD) detection.
Both aim to improve the robustness of classifiers by detecting test-time distributional shifts.
blocks.zh:
图像识别深层学习方法的迅速进步日益促进其真实世界的采用,这就要求它们充分发现和处理未知的投入,以确保这些系统的可靠性和安全性[Scheirer等 (2013年)Scheirer, de Rezende Rocha, Sapkota, 和 Boult, Hendrycks and Gimpel (2017年), Vaze等 (2022年) Vaze, Han, Vedaldi, 和 Zissermann].
这项任务通常在两个密切相关的问题表述下加以研究: 开机识别(OSR)和出发(OOD)检测.
两者都旨在通过检测测试-时间分布的相变来提高分类器的稳健性.

blocks.en:
While the categorization of OSR methods into representation learning and postprocessing methods is commonly understood, current OSR methods are studied in isolation or compared as standalone methods, neglecting their differences and modular nature and potential for improvements through combinations.
Since the interaction effects between representation learning and postprocessors have neither been explored nor formalized for OSR methods, we ask: can representation learning methods enhance or shape feature representations to amplify downstream postprocessors performance?
Or vice versa: is the optimal choice of postprocessor dependent on the representation learning training objective?
blocks.zh:
虽然人们通常理解将业务SR方法归类为代表学习和后处理方法,但将目前的业务SR方法孤立地加以研究或作为独立方法进行比较,忽略了它们的差异和模块性质以及通过组合改进的潜力.
由于表现学习和后处理器之间的相互作用效应既没有被探讨,也没有被正式确定为操作SR方法,我们问:表现学习方法能否加强或塑造特征表现来扩大下游后处理器的性能?
或者反之:处理器的最佳选择取决于代表学习培训的目标吗?

blocks.en:
Figure 1 : Open-Set Recognition Framework . The modular two-stage OSR framework separates representation learning and postprocessing, and reveals additional performance gains, by leveraging interaction effects between the two.
Undesirable interaction effects exist for magnitude-manipulating representation learning (red) combined with magnitude-aware postprocessors (blue), while beneficial effects are observed for K + 1 K+1 class classifiers and magnitude-aware postprocessors.
Small-scale benchmarks are not predictive of large-scale performance and do not exhibit similar behavior due to limited similarity between known and known unknown classes.
blocks.zh:
图1: 开放式确认框架 模块化的两阶段业务社会责任框架将表现学习和后处理分开,并通过利用两者之间的互动效应,揭示更多的业绩收益。
对量子调控的表达式学习(红色)与量子意识后处理器(蓝色)存在不理想的相互作用效应,而对于K+1 K+1类分类器和量子意识后处理器则观察到有益的效应.
小规模基准对大规模性能不具有预测性,由于已知和已知未知类别之间的有限相似性,因此没有表现出类似行为.

blocks.en:
In both representation learning and postprocessing methods, the feature magnitude has been identified as a crucial factor for performance with unknown data observing smaller feature magnitudes [ Dhamija et al.(2018)Dhamija, Günther, and Boult , Hendrycks et al.(2022)Hendrycks, Basart, Mazeika, Zou, Kwon, Mostajabi, Steinhardt, and Song , Vaze et al.(2022)Vaze, Han, Vedaldi, and Zissermann , Cruz et al.(2024)Cruz, Rabinowitz, Günther, and Boult , Rabinowitz et al.(2025)Rabinowitz, Cruz, Günther, and Boult ] .
For instance, ?? [ Wang et al.(2025)Wang, Vaze, and Han ] highlight that magnitude-aware (MA) OOD postprocessing generally outperforms alternatives. This raises the question: do MA postprocessors synergize with representation learning methods that purposefully manipulate feature magnitudes during training?
We identify a sub-category of representation learning methods, which we term magnitude-manipulating (MM), that utilize known unknown data to separate known and known unknown classes during training based on feature magnitude.
However, MM methods tend to be sensitive to known unknown data distribution at large scale, with performance falling below baselines, despite their success on small-scale datasets [ Hendrycks et al.(2021)Hendrycks, Zhao, Basart, Steinhardt, and Song , Wang et al.(2025)Wang, Vaze, and Han ] . This raises concerns about their real-world applicability, and we seek to understand the underlying causes of this performance degradation at scale.
blocks.zh:
在表现学习和后处理方法中,特征分量被确定为性能的关键因素,观测特征分量较小的数据不详[Dhamija等(2018)Dhamija、Günther和Boult、Hendrycks等(2022)Hendrycks、Basart、Mazeika、Zou、Kwon、Mostajabi、Steinhardt和Song、Vaze等(2022)Vaze、Han、Vedaldi和Zisermann、Cruz等(2024)Cruz、Rabinowitz、Günther和Boult、Rabinowitz等(2025)Rabinowitz、Cruz、Günther和Boult]。
比如说? [Wang等人(2025年)Wang,Vaze,和Han]强调,体积感知(MA)OOD后处理一般优于替代品。 这就提出了这样一个问题:MA后处理器是否与有意在训练中操纵特有规模的代表学习方法相协同?
我们确定了一种代表性学习方法的子类别,我们称之为 " 规模调控 " (MM),它利用已知的未知数据,在根据地貌大小进行的训练中将已知的和已知的未知的班级分开。
然而,MM方法往往对大规模已知的未知数据分布敏感,其性能也低于基线,尽管它们在小规模数据集上取得了成功[Hendrycks等 (2021)Hendrycks, Zhao, Basart, Steinhardt, and Song, Wang等 (2025) Wang, 瓦兹,还有汉 这引起了人们对其现实世界适用性的关切,我们力求从规模上理解这种业绩退化的根本原因。

blocks.en:
Our analysis reveals the mechanism behind the performance degradation of MM methods as the interplay of magnitude-manipulation and high similarity between known unknown and known classes, a scenario not found on small-scale benchmarks.
This causes a magnitude collapse in similar known classes and creates an undesirable linear dependency between feature magnitudes and class-wise accuracy, leading to systematically imbalanced class-wise detection performance. We show that magnitude collapse can be avoided by using an additional output node (a K + 1 K+1 class) for known unknown data, a simple and effective baseline that consistently outperforms other methods across scales and does not require hyperparameter tuning.
This performance degradation of MM methods is further amplified by MA postprocessing, which otherwise experiences desirable interaction effects when combined with non-MM representation learning methods and outperforms other postprocessors.
Moreover, our experiments suggest that representation learning without known unknown data and postprocessors are highly independent components of OSR systems with clear separation of responsibilities, enabling modular additive performance gains.
blocks.zh:
我们的分析显示,MM方法的性能退化背后的机制是,在已知未知和已知类别之间发生量能操纵和高度相似的相互作用,而小规模基准中找不到这种情况。
这在相类似的已知类中造成规模倒塌并造成地物分级和分级精度之间不可取的线性依赖,导致分级分级检测性能的系统性不平衡. 我们显示,通过对已知的未知数据使用额外的输出节点(a K + 1 K+1等),可以避免规模倒塌,这个简单而有效的基线在跨尺度上一贯地超过其他方法,不需要超参数调取.
MM方法的性能退化被MA后处理所进一步放大,否则在与非MM代表学习方法相结合并超越了其他后处理器时,MM方法会遇到所希望的相互作用效应.
此外,我们的实验表明,在没有已知未知数据和后处理器的情况下进行代表学习,是业务记录系统高度独立的部分,责任明确分离,能够实现模块化添加剂性能增益。

blocks.en:
Overall, our study advances the understanding of OSR systems and provides actionable guidelines for researchers and practitioners.
First, leverage the modularity of OSR systems by augmenting non-MM representation learning methods with MA postprocessors to achieve additional performance gains almost for free.
Second, when training or fine-tuning a classifier with known unknown data that is visually similar to known classes, avoid MM representation learning methods.
Instead, use a K + 1 K+1 class classifier as baseline to mitigate magnitude collapse and leverage positive interaction effects.
Finally, validate OSR methods on large-scale benchmarks before deployment, as small-scale evaluations are not predictive of large-scale performance.
blocks.zh:
总体而言,我们的研究增进了对业务社会责任体系的理解,并为研究人员和从业人员提供了可操作的准则。
首先,通过用MA后处理器增强非MM代表式学习方法来利用OSR系统的模块化,几乎免费地实现额外的性能收益.
其次,在培训或微调已知未知数据与已知班级相近的分类器时,避免使用MM代表学习方法.
取而代之的是,使用K+1 K+1类分类器作为基线来缓解星等倒塌并发挥正相互作用效应.
最后,在部署前验证大规模基准的作业社会责任方法,因为小规模评价不能预测大规模业绩。

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are as follows: • For the first time in OSR literature, we explore the modularity and interaction effects of representation learning and postprocessing methods through two-stage OSR, revealing where modular performance gains can be achieved and where to avoid negative synergies. • We discover the magnitude collapse mechanism behind performance degradation at scale and how it impacts interaction effects. • We demonstrate how interaction effects and known unknown data can be leveraged at scale to achieve state-of-the-art performance regardless of known unknown data distribution with the simple K + 1 K+1 class baseline and two-stage processing of OSR techniques. • Our experiments highlight that small-scale evaluations are not predictive of large-scale performance when using known unknown data.
blocks.zh: 简言之,我们的贡献如下: 在业务标准文献中,我们第一次通过两阶段业务标准来探索表现学习和后处理方法的模块性和相互作用效应,揭示模块性能的提高可以在哪里实现,避免负面的协同作用。 我们发现大规模性能退化背后的规模倒塌机制及其如何影响相互作用效应。 我们示范如何在规模上利用相互作用效应和已知的未知数据实现最新性能,而不论已知的未知数据分布如何,简单K+1K+1类基线和两相处理OSR技术. 二. 支助 我们的实验强调,在使用已知的未知数据时,小规模评价不能预测大规模性能。

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
OSR is formalized as the task of accurately classifying samples from known classes while rejecting samples from semantically unknown classes [ Scheirer et al.(2013)Scheirer, de Rezende Rocha, Sapkota, and Boult ] , thereby detecting test-time semantic shift [ Vaze et al.(2022)Vaze, Han, Vedaldi, and Zissermann ] .
OOD detection is a broader task [ Yang et al.(2024)Yang, Zhou, Li, and Liu ] that aims to detect general distribution shift, which can include semantic or covariate shifts [ Yang et al.(2024)Yang, Zhou, Li, and Liu , Wang et al.(2025)Wang, Vaze, and Han , Hendrycks et al.(2021)Hendrycks, Zhao, Basart, Steinhardt, and Song ] and is often posed as a binary classification problem [ Hendrycks and Gimpel(2017) , Liang et al.(2017)Liang, Li, and Srikant , Liu et al.(2020)Liu, Wang, Owens, and Li , Huang et al.(2021)Huang, Geng, and Li , Sun et al.(2021)Sun, Guo, and Li ] .
As a result, OSR and OOD detection differ in their evaluation protocols [ Vaze et al.(2022)Vaze, Han, Vedaldi, and Zissermann , Wang et al.(2025)Wang, Vaze, and Han ] : OSR partitions a single dataset into known and unknown classes to mitigate covariate shifts [ Neal et al.(2018)Neal, Olson, Fern, Wong, and Li , Palechor et al.(2023)Palechor, Bhoumik, and Günther ] , while OOD detection typically uses different datasets for in-distribution (ID) and OOD classes [ Hendrycks and Gimpel(2017) ] .
Despite these differences, it has been indicated that methods that perform well on one task tend to perform well on the other [ Vaze et al.(2022)Vaze, Han, Vedaldi, and Zissermann , Yang et al.(2024)Yang, Zhou, Li, and Liu , Wang et al.(2025)Wang, Vaze, and Han ] .
blocks.zh:
OSR被正式确定为一项任务,即准确分类来自已知阶层的样本,同时拒绝来自Scheirer等人(2013年)Scheirer、de Rezende Rocha、Sapkota和Boult)的样本,从而发现测试时间语义变化[Vaze等人(2022年)Vaze、Han、Vedaldi和Zissermann]。
OD检测是一项更广泛的任务[Yang等人(2024年)Yang, 周恩来 Li, and Liu]),旨在检测出一般分布相变,这可以包括语义相变或相变相相变相[杨等(2024)Yang,. 周恩来 李克用,又作刘克用,王等(2025年) 汪克用,活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活活 Li, and Srikant, Liu et al.(2020)Liu,, (原始内容存档于2018-09-21). 王爷 欧文斯;和李克用; 黄等 (2021年) 韩克用; 耿克用;和李克用; 孙等 (2021年) 孙克用; 郭克用; 李克用.
因此,OSR和OOD检测在评价协议上有所不同[Vaze等人(2022年)Vaze, Han, Vedaldi, 和Zissermann, Wang等人(2025年)Wang, 瓦兹,和汉: OSR将一个单一的数据集分入已知和未知的类别来缓解共变变相的变相 [Neal等 (2018) Neal, Olson, Fern, Wong, and Li等 (2023) Palechor等 (2023) Palechor, Bhoumik, and Günther)],而OOD检测则通常使用不同的数据集进行分化(ID)和OOD类别 [Hendrycks and Gimpel (2017)].
尽管存在这些差异,但有人指出,在一项任务上表现良好的方法往往在另一项任务上表现良好[Vaze等人(2022年)Vaze、Han、Vedaldi和Zissermann, Yang等人(2024年)Yang, 周恩来 李克用; 刘克用; 王等 (2025) 汪克用; 刘克用. 瓦兹,还有汉

blocks.en:
Known unknown samples serve as a proxy for unknown classes during training and are distinct from known or ID classes [ Scheirer et al.(2014)Scheirer, Jain, and Boult , Dhamija et al.(2018)Dhamija, Günther, and Boult ] .
Known unknown samples are also referred to as outlier images [ Kong and Ramanan(2021) ] , natural adversarial examples [ Hendrycks et al.(2021)Hendrycks, Zhao, Basart, Steinhardt, and Song ] , and negative samples [ Palechor et al.(2023)Palechor, Bhoumik, and Günther ] .
Real known unknown data is used for OOD detection [ Hendrycks et al.(2019)Hendrycks, Mazeika, and Dietterich , Liu et al.(2020)Liu, Wang, Owens, and Li ] and OSR [ Dhamija et al.(2018)Dhamija, Günther, and Boult , Palechor et al.(2023)Palechor, Bhoumik, and Günther ] , dating back to the earliest approaches [ Scheirer et al.(2014)Scheirer, Jain, and Boult ] . While a large attention in OSR research is paid to artificially generate known unknown samples [ Ge et al.(2017)Ge, Demyanov, and Garnavi , Neal et al.(2018)Neal, Olson, Fern, Wong, and Li , Chen et al.(2020)Chen, Qiao, Shi, Peng, Li, Huang, Pu, and Tian , Chen et al.(2021)Chen, Peng, Wang, and Tian ] , in this study we exclude generative methods and instead use real known unknown data.
The standard small-scale benchmarks MNIST, CIFAR, SVHN, and TinyImageNet partition all classes into known and unknown [ Neal et al.(2018)Neal, Olson, Fern, Wong, and Li ] , therefore do not allow any known unknown classes.
The large-scale Semantic Shift Benchmark (SSB) [ Vaze et al.(2022)Vaze, Han, Vedaldi, and Zissermann ] uses the entire ImageNet-1K dataset as known classes and selects unknowns from a set of disjoint classes from ImageNet-21K-P.
blocks.zh:
已知未知样本是培训期间未知课程的代名词,与已知或ID课程不同[Scheirer等(2014年)Scheirer, Jain,以及Boult, Dhamija等(2018年)Dhamija, Günther, 和Boult].
已知的未知样本还被指外出图像[Kong和Ramanan(2021)],自然对抗性实例[Hendrycks等 (2021)Hendrycks, Zhao, Basart, Steinhardt, and Song],以及负面样本[Palechor等 (2023)Palechor, Bhoumik, and Günther].
实际已知的未知数据被用于OD检测[Hendrycks等人(2019年)Hendrycks, Mazeika, and Dietrich, Liu等人(2020年)Liu, 王爷 Owens, and Li)和OSR [Dhamija等 (2018) Dhamija, Günther, and Boult, Palechor等 (2023)Palechor, Bhoumik, and Günther],可以追溯到最早的取道[Scheirer等 (2014)Scheirer, Jain, and Boult]]. 虽然在OSR研究中大量关注人工生成已知未知样本[Ge等 (2017)Ge, Demyanov, and Garnavi., Neal等 (2018)Neal, Olson, Fern, Wong, and Li., Chen等 (2020)Chen, 小强 史记 阿鹏 丽 黄, 浦,和天., Chen等 (2021)Chen, 阿鹏 Wang, and Tian],在本研究中,我们排除了基因方法,而是使用真正已知的未知数据.
MNIST、CIFAR、SVHN和TinyImageNet的标准小规模基准将所有类别划入已知和未知的类别[Neal等(2018)Neal, Olson, Fern, Wong, and Li]),因此不允许任何已知的未知类别.
大规模语义移位基准(SSB) [Vaze等 (2022) Vaze, Han, Vedaldi, and Zissermann)]使用整个ImageNet-1K数据集作为已知的类,并从ImageNet-21K-P的一组脱节类中选择未知.

blocks.en: 3 Modular two-stage framework for OSR
blocks.zh: 3 业务SR模块化两阶段框架

blocks.en:
Figure 2 : Two-Stage Processing Framework for OSR . An image is presented to the backbone network F F , which extracts deep features φ \mathbf{\varphi} that are then processed with a linear layer 𝐖 \mathbf{W} to logits 𝐳 \mathbf{z} , and further with SoftMax to probabilities 𝐲 \mathbf{y} .
Solid lines indicate (potentially) learnable connections, while dashed lines highlight non-learnable connections.

We choose five representation learning approaches, based on whether the method requires known unknown data and whether it (explicitly or implicitly) manipulates the feature magnitude.

To evaluate our methods we use multiple metrics to capture different aspects of performance.
AUOSCR and OOSA lack the interpretability of closed-set accuracy and AUROC, and therefore should not be solely relied upon.
On the other hand, the latter do not measure OSR performance holistically [ Wang et al.(2022)Wang, Xu, Yang, He, Cao, and Huang ] .
For example, closed-set accuracy is incapable of measuring interaction effects because all postprocessors except OpenMax exclusively rely on the logit order from upstream representation learning methods to produce predictions k ∗ k^{*} and ignore γ ∗ \gamma^{*} , resulting in identical accuracy scores (Figure 13(d) in the Supplemental).
AUROC measures the ability to separate known and unknown samples across all thresholds via γ ∗ \gamma^{*} and ignores k ∗ k^{*} , thereby directly measuring the discriminative ability of the postprocessor and indirectly of the representation learning method.
AUOSCR and OOSA however jointly measure the quality of k ∗ k^{*} and γ ∗ \gamma^{*} for any given threshold θ \theta via CCR ⁡ ( θ ) \mathrm{CCR}(\theta) and FPR ⁡ ( θ ) \mathrm{FPR}(\theta) .
As such we rely primarily on AUOSCR and OOSA to answer our research questions but draw complementary insights from closed-set accuracy and AUROC.

On CIFAR+N, all representation learning methods utilizing known unknown data systematically outperform those that do not by up to 5.9 percentage points in AUOSCR with MSP. State-of-the-art ARPL achieves consistent but negligible improvements over CE for any given postprocessor.
With known classes being held constant between CIFAR+10 and CIFAR+50, we can see that additional known unknown data consistently improves AUOSCR by over 2 percentage points, even when evaluated on more unknown classes.
For all representation learning methods, the variations across postprocessors are comparably small, suggesting that representation learning contributes more toward overall performance than postprocessors on small-scale benchmarks, likely due to the limited diversity between known classes and the large distributional gap between known and unknown classes that can easily be exploited by representation learning methods with known unknown data.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
In this study, we adopt a two-stage framework for modularly combining representation learning and postprocessing methods for Open-Set Recognition (OSR). We show that representation learning without known unknown data leads to independent OSR components, that can be freely combined to achieve additive performance gains, whereas representation learning with known unknown data can experience interaction effects with postprocessors that can improve or degrade OSR performance.
We explain this performance degradation and the key role of feature magnitude in interaction effects via the magnitude collapse mechanism, revealing several insights.
First, the similarity between known unknown and known classes is a key factor for performance degradation at scale, a scenario that does not occur on small-scale benchmarks.
Second, magnitude collapse creates an undesirable linear dependency between feature magnitude and class-wise detection performance on the in-distribution and OSR task, leading to systematically imbalanced detection across known classes.
Furthermore, we demonstrate how magnitude collapse can be circumvented by the simple yet effective baseline K + 1 K+1 class and that, contrary to recent findings, training with known unknown data can improve OSR performance at any scale and regardless of known unknown data selection.
Our findings invalidate current best practices in OSR, demonstrating that small-scale evaluations with known unknown data do not translate to large-scale performance.
Generally, small-scale experiments are primarily driven by representation learning via inclusion of known unknown data and favor the simpler postprocessors like MaxLogits, while large-scale experiments benefit from combining representation learning and postprocessing, mainly through joining K + 1 K+1 class with MA postprocessors like PostMax or GHOST.
As such, representation learning methods considered state-of-the-art based on CIFAR benchmarks, such as Outlier Exposure, can degrade significantly below baselines at scale.
blocks.zh:
在这项研究中,我们采用了一个两阶段框架,将代表学习和后处理方法组合在一起,用于公开的确认。 我们显示,在没有已知未知数据的情况下进行代表学习会导致独立的OSR组件,这些组件可以自由结合以实现添加性能增益,而利用已知未知数据进行代表学习可以与后处理器发生相互作用效应,可以提高或降低OSR性能.
我们通过规模倒塌机制来解释这种性能退化以及特征规模在相互作用效应中的重要作用,揭示出若干见解。
首先,已知的未知类别和已知类别之间的相似性是规模性能退化的关键因素,这种情景并不发生在小规模基准上。
第二,星等倒塌造成特征星等与分流和OSR任务上的分级检测性能之间不可取的线性依赖,导致已知各类的检测系统不平衡.
此外,我们证明,简单而有效的K+1K+1类基线如何能避免规模倒塌,而且,与最近的调查结果相反,使用已知未知数据的培训可以在任何规模上,无论已知未知数据选择如何,提高操作SR的性能。
我们的调查结果否定了业务审计标准中目前的最佳做法,表明有已知未知数据的小规模评价不会转化为大规模业绩。
一般来说,小型实验主要是通过纳入已知的未知数据来进行代表学习,并喜欢像MaxLogits这样的更简单的后处理器;而大型实验则得益于代表学习和后处理的结合,主要通过将K+1 K+1类与PostMax或GHOST等MA后处理器相接而来.
因此,根据CIFAR基准,如Outlier Opture,被认为是最先进的代表学习方法,可以大大降低基线。

We selected postprocessors to cover a split between representative magnitude-aware and magnitude-unaware methods.
Furthermore, we aim to cover both trainable and non-trainable methods to include methods that can specifically adjust to differently learned representations.
Following, we discuss each method and its formalization in the two-stage framework in more detail.

blocks.en: A.4 EMNIST Benchmark
blocks.zh: A.4. 管理信息系统基准

blocks.en:
We perform qualitative small-scale experiments on the EMNIST protocol [ Dhamija et al.(2018)Dhamija, Günther, and Boult ] to replicate settings of high similarity between known and known unknown classes at small scale.
This benchmark contains a wide spectrum of clearly attributable visual similarities between known and known unknown classes because the samples do not contain any image background.
It consists of EMNIST MNIST split as knowns, the first half of EMNIST letters (a-m) as known unknown data, and the second half (n-z) as unknowns. 8 8 8 Contrary to [ Dhamija et al.(2018)Dhamija, Günther, and Boult ] we use EMNIST MNIST instead of the original MNIST because the preprocessing, while similar, is not exact [ Cohen et al.(2017)Cohen, Afshar, Tapson, and van Schaik ] . EMNIST MNIST and letters contain noticeably softer and thicker digits than MNIST. In order to focus on semantic shift and not introduce easily learnable covariate shift through softness and sharpness, we use EMNIST MNIST. While most digits (known) do not contain any visually similar letters, digits 1 and 9 contain known unknown classes (“i”, “l” and “g”, “q” respectively) that are visually very similar or indistinguishable without context depending on handwriting and capitalization.
blocks.zh:
我们在EMNIST协议[Dhamija et al.(2018)Dhamija、Günther和Boult]上进行定性小规模实验,以小规模地复制已知和已知未知类别之间的高度相似环境。
这个基准包含了已知和已知未知类别之间可明显归属的多种视觉相似性,因为样本中没有任何图像背景.
它由已知的EMNIST MNIST分裂组成,前半个为已知未知数据(a-m)的EMNIST字母,后半个为未知数据(n-z). 8,8 与[Dhamija等 (2018) Dhamija, Günther, and Boult]相反,我们使用EMNIST MNIST代替原来的MNIST,因为预处理虽然相似,但并不准确 [Cohen等 (2017) Cohen, Afshar, Tapson, and van Schaik]. EMIST MNIST和字母中含有比MNIST明显更软更厚的位数. 为了专注于语义转变,而不会通过柔软和尖锐引入容易被学习的相变转变,我们使用EMNIST MNIST. 虽然大多数数字(已知)不包含任何视觉相近的字母,但数字1和9则包含已知的未知类别(“i”、“l”和“g”、“q”),这些类别视笔迹和资本化情况而非常相近或无法区分。

blocks.en:
To visualize how magnitude collapse and known class classification interacts, we repeat the EMNIST experiments with a 2D bottleneck deep feature layer, following ?? [ Dhamija et al.(2018)Dhamija, Günther, and Boult ] .
These can illustrate how different representation learning methods structure the feature space and how this affects postprocessors, however, the low dimensionality limits not only the representational capacity but also changes the geometry of the feature space and the behavior, so extrapolation to high dimensional feature spaces is limited.
Experiments are otherwise identical to those in Section 4 .

The OSCR curve [ Dhamija et al.(2018)Dhamija, Günther, and Boult ] simultaneously evaluates classification of known samples via CCR as well as the rejection of unknown samples via FPR over all possible thresholds.

blocks.en: A.7 Experiments on Additional Postprocessing Methods
blocks.zh: A.7 关于附加后处理方法的实验

blocks.en:
To assess the generalizability of our findings, we conducted additional experiments on four widely used postprocessing methods that were not included in the main paper.
Particularly, we include Energy [ Liu et al.(2020)Liu, Wang, Owens, and Li ] , ODIN [ Liang et al.(2017)Liang, Li, and Srikant ] , ReAct+Energy [ Sun et al.(2021)Sun, Guo, and Li ] , and ASH-S [ Djurisic et al.(2023)Djurisic, Bozanic, Ashok, and Liu ] .
The AUOSCR heatmaps for combinations on CIFAR+N and ImageNet are shown in Figure 13 and Figure 11 , respectively.
For Energy and ODIN we observe nearly identical effects as previous postprocessors, while ReAct+Energy and ASH-S struggled with high-similarity setting P 3 P_{3} (shifting the color-map and slightly hiding the effect).
On the smaller CIFAR+N dataset, we observe that ReAct+Energy and ASH-S can exhibit high variation in performance, dragging down the average performance significantly, while other poseprocessors are highly stable.

为了评估我们的调查结果的普遍性,我们对未包括在主要文件中的四种广泛使用的后处理方法进行了更多的试验。
特别是,我们包括能源[刘等(2020)Liu, 王爷 Owens, and Li], ODIN [梁等 (2017) 梁等. Li, and Srikant ], ReAct+ Energy [Sun等 (2021) Sun, Guo, and Li], and ASH-S [Djurisic等 (2023) Djurisic, Bozanic, Ashok, and Liu].
用于CIFAR+N和ImageNet上的组合的AUOSCR热图分别见图13和图11。
对于 Energy 和 ODIN , 我们观测到和之前的后处理器几乎相同的效果, 而 ReAct+ Energy 和 ASH-S 则在高度相似性设置 P 3 P_{3 } ( 转换颜色图并略隐藏效果) 下挣扎.
在较小的CIFAR+上 N数据集,我们观测到ReAct+ Energy和ASH-S的性能可以表现出高差异,显著地拖低了平均性能,而其他平面处理器则高度稳定.
